_comment: Copy to env.json (and env.android.json with SUPABASE_URL=http://10.0.2.2:54321 for the Android emulator). Get the publishable key from `supabase status`. For a physical device, use your machine's LAN IP, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:54321.
_comment_sentry: Crash reporting. Leave SENTRY_DSN empty for local dev and CI — an empty DSN disables reporting cleanly, which is why it is not validated at startup the way the Supabase values are. Set it only in env.prod.json. The DSN is not a secret (it ships in every client and only permits writes) but stays out of git so a fork's crashes don't land in this project's inbox. SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT defaults to 'production' in a release build and 'development' otherwise; set it explicitly for a staging deploy.
